title: identity.principal.issued v1 data
description: A principal was issued credentials. AUDIT RECORD: this type is sourced into PF_AUDIT and kept 365 days. It carries the FACT of issuance and never the credential itself. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

principalId.description: Stable opaque identifier for the principal. Not an email address and not a name.

principalType.description: Kind of principal. `ai-agent` is a first-class type, not a service account with a convention.

issuer.description: Identity center that issued it, as an operator-supplied issuer URI. Never a hard-coded provider.

credentialRef.description: Reference to where the credential lives (e.g. a secret store path). NEVER the credential material — an audit stream holding secrets is a 365-day breach.

expiresAt.description: RFC3339 expiry. Absent means non-expiring, which is itself an auditable fact.
